title: Draft Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Grid Interactive Distributed Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2026

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: These Regulations shall repeal the Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Net Metering Rooftop Solar PV Grid Interactive Systems) Regulations, 2016 and subsequent amendments.

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: Regulations for Net Metering Rooftop Solar PV Grid Interactive Systems

candidate_clauses.note: DRAFT: not in force as of 2026-10-01 per landing page; do not use as live supersession without confirming notification.

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Draft Reg 6.2 (no feasibility study up to 10 kW)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The applications for DRES up to 10 kW capacity, complete in all respects shall be deemed to have been accepted without requiring technical feasibility study
